newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re details investment, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re details investment, earnings.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co said investment profits rose 27 percent to 3,309 million Swiss francs in 1996 from the year before and return on investment grew to seven percent.
"As a result of favourable developments on the financial markets, substantially higher capital gains were realised," Swiss Re said in a statement on 1996 financial results.
The technical result in life business rose 18 percent to 178 million, Swiss Re added.
The technical result in non-life business rose 19 percent to 716 million Swiss francs, the company said.
"The combined ratio (sum of claims and expenses relating to the reinsurance business in relation to premiums) rose from 108 percent to 109 percent," it said.
This included an allocation of 435 million Swiss francs to provisions for catastrophe risks.
"The slightly lower claims ratio compares to higher commission and expense ratios," it said without elaborating.
Swiss Re promised more detail on its 1996 results at a news conference and presentation to financial analysts on May 20.
A letter to shareholders and invitation to the annual general meeting would be sent out on May 5, Swiss Re said.
